moves.name: Spout Flick
moves.note: Set knockback. Chains to jab 2 on A.

moves.name: Lid Crash
moves.note: Chargeable to x1.4. Claps the lid like a cymbal.

moves.name: Whistle Blast
moves.note: Steam geyser from the spout. Anti-air.

moves.name: Spin Pour
moves.note: Hits both sides (rear hit frame 14). Low angle: sets up edge-guards.

moves.name: Steam Puff
moves.note: Ring projectile, 7 u/s, lives 70 f. Shoves more than it hurts. Piping: 3 hits x 3%, BKB 18.

moves.name: Spout Charge
moves.note: Lunges 5 u. Piping: 7 u, armour f8-21 vs hits under 10%.

moves.name: Lid Pop
moves.note: Rises 4.6 u, then helpless fall. Piping: 6.2 u, KBG 18.

moves.name: Steep
moves.note: Hold 50 f to store one Piping charge (lid rattles, whistle). Lost if launched into tumble.

moves.name: Gore
moves.note: Chargeable. The strongest single hit in the game.

moves.name: Quake Stomp
moves.note: Both sides. +30 crack to the chunk underfoot.

moves.name: Suplex
moves.note: KO throw. +15 crack where they land.

moves.name: Snort
moves.note: Cone gust 3.5 u. Pure shove: also pushes projectiles, rubble and gadgets.

moves.name: Stampede
moves.note: Runs 11 u/s for up to 60 f, armour vs hits under 10%. First fighter touched is carried on the horns (unblockable) up to 40 f, then tossed (the listed hit). He does NOT stop at ledges.

moves.name: Rodeo
moves.note: Bucking leap, 3.6 u at 60 deg. His only real recovery, and it is short.

moves.name: Stamp
moves.note: Ground: shockwave 3 u each side pops grounded fighters; +45 crack underfoot. Air: dives at 26 u/s, spikes on the way down (BKB 6, KBG 12, 270 deg).

moves.name: Mitten Slap
moves.note: Fastest move in the game (Small: 2 f).

moves.name: Pop Top
moves.note: Head springs up on a coil.

moves.name: Corkscrew
moves.note: Drill: 5 hits of 1.5%, final hit 3% is a weak spike.

moves.name: Whirligig
moves.note: Spinning top: 6 hits of 1.5% then 4% launcher. Steerable at 5 u/s. Slides off ledges.

moves.name: Skittle
moves.clean: 236 + S: 10%, passes through instead of bouncing back
moves.note: Tips over and rolls at 12 u/s for up to 45 f. Jump-cancel from f12. Bounces back on hit.

moves.name: Up She Pops
moves.note: Rises 3.8 / 4.6 / 5.4 u by size. Helpless fall after.

moves.name: Shed
moves.clean: 214 + S: the empty shell is kicked forward at 14 u/s
moves.note: Pops out of her shell one size smaller, invulnerable f1-12, hop 2.2 u. The empty shell stays as a heavy prop for 6 s or 3 hits; struck, it becomes a projectile (the listed hit). Twice per stock. Guard break sheds a shell instead of stunning her.

moves.name: Line Trip
moves.note: Hits low. Barely launches: sets up Cast.

moves.name: Sinker
moves.note: Drops a lead weight (16 u/s). Weak spike. One on screen.

moves.name: Hook and Line
moves.note: Tether grab, reach 3.2 u. Slow, long recovery on whiff.

moves.name: Cast
moves.note: Hook flies 16 u/s in an arc, reach 8 u. Hooks the first fighter, rubble, gadget, parcel or chunk. Hold S: reel (13 u/s). Tap A: Yank, flinging the catch over his head (the listed hit). Any hit on the line cuts it.

moves.name: Bobber
moves.clean: 236 + S: bobber is thrown 40% further and pops for 7%
moves.note: Lobs a float that sits for 4 s and pops on touch. Two on screen. Anyone can hit it away.

moves.name: Tether Cast
moves.clean: 623 + S: reach 11 u, zip has a 5% hitbox
moves.note: Hook reaches 9 u at 45-135 deg. Latches terrain, ledges, loose chunks and rubble: zips there at 20 u/s. Latches a fighter: zips to them and bonks (the listed hit). Nothing to hook = nothing happens.

moves.name: Gone Fishin'
moves.note: Sits and fishes off whatever he is standing on. Result: 60% rubble, 30% old boot (throw: 6%), 9% random gadget, 1% a fish that slaps him.
